free_tier.stated: No quota. Live server stats: 1,375,309 total blobs, 781.96 GB storage used, 8,684 uploads/24 h. Max upload size 2 GB, max media size 1 GB, accepted types `*`.

chaining: 2 GB per object makes it the best per-file ratio in the Blossom set; SHA-256 addressing composes directly with the chunk-and-replicate pattern.
limits_note: 2 GB/upload, 1 GB for /media; images re-encoded to webp @192 by the server's media optimisation (so /media is lossy, but /upload of a raw blob is not)

identity_cost.detail: anonymous — Nostr keypair (BUD-11 auth token). No email.

reliability_note: Operator-run hobby infrastructure with ~782 GB on disk; a 500 GB deposit would double the server. No published retention, unlike 24242.io.
